```c

if (r != SC_SUCCESS || tagp == NULL) {
    printf("Error in decoding.\n");
    return;
}
```

But let me look at the check in `print_tags_recursive`:
```c
if (len + hlen > bytesleft) {

    return;
}
```

This seems to be a proper bounds check. So the `print_tags_recursive` looks safe.

                    break;

```
